title: GTA 6: 7 Things To Know Before Launch #Shorts

scenes.text: Grand Theft Auto 6 is set to launch on November nineteenth, twenty twenty six.
It arrives on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S first. There is no PC version at launch.
It is the first new main Grand Theft Auto game since GTA 5, which launched back in twenty thirteen.
The story takes place in Leonida, Rockstar's fictional take on Florida.
At its heart is Vice City, the series' version of Miami.
Rockstar has shown two lead characters, Lucia and Jason.
And the first trailer set a record for views in its first twenty four hours.
Follow for more Grand Theft Auto 6 news.

description:
Quick rundown of what Rockstar has publicly announced about Grand Theft Auto VI: the release date, platforms, setting and lead characters.

Information based on Rockstar's public announcements as of November 17, 2026. Release details can change, so check Rockstar's official channels for updates.

All visuals in this video are original graphics. No game footage is used.
